assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: 官方精确红线与三处重点区域正式 polygon 尚未公开；本方案全部空间图层派生自仓库 provisional 粗略边界（DATA-SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARIES-20260605）。
assumptions.impact: 全部面积、比例与长度指标为临时几何口径的设计模型值；正式数据发布后，用地划分、绿地/公共空间、建筑体量与全部指标需按同一脚本流程复算更新。

assumptions.statement: 社区 Issue #1029 指出临时重点区 PROV-KEY-003（大钟寺）质心相对大钟寺站存在约 2.26km 偏移争议。
assumptions.impact: 本方案仅将三处重点区作为南北序列中的粗略定位，不据此推导任何精确面积、四至或权属结论。

assumptions.statement: buildings.geojson 为概念体量示意（点式/条式网格生成），不代表建筑高度、容积率、地块拆分或权属结论。
assumptions.impact: 建筑基底面积与密度仅为设计意图量级参考；法定指标待官方控规条件公开后由专业团队确定。

assumptions.statement: 分期推进节奏取决于各期进入门与验收门通过情况（blocking_now=false），不设固定年份时间表。
assumptions.impact: 实施时序为条件门机制，避免在概念阶段做出不可控的时间承诺。

assumptions.statement: RACI 工作包矩阵中的责任主体（R/A/C/I）使用组织类型泛称，具体执行主体在深化阶段由项目协调机制议定。
assumptions.impact: 工作包界定权责分工结构，不预设具体企业或单位的法定授权。

assumptions.statement: 更新项目行动包的成本级（S/M/L）为概念估算类别（S<500万/M 500-2000万/L>2000万），非投资测算或财政承诺。
assumptions.impact: 供深化阶段投资策划参考，不构成法定预算分配。

assumptions.statement: 本方案全部内容为概念建议与设计构想，未获任何行政审批、规划许可或法定授权。
assumptions.impact: 所有空间设计与治理协议在落地前须按法定程序报批。

assumptions.statement: AI+ 场景与三个产业测试验证场景的验收条件为概念指引区间，本方案未开展任何现场实测或模型标定。
assumptions.impact: 实际验收阈值与测试协议须由实施主体会同专业机构在试点启动前标定公示。

assumptions.statement: 全场景保留等价非 AI 通道（no-AI-equivalent route）与人工服务界面，智能层失效或停用时服务品质不低于基线。
assumptions.impact: 弱势群体权益与公共客厅属性得到结构性制度兜底。

assumptions.statement: 气数协议（QP-1~QP-7）与八类岗位规格为概念治理建议（v0.1），独立复核者与运营岗互斥以保证复核公信力。
assumptions.impact: 提供可复算的治理演练范式，实际运营体制依主管部门决定设立。

assumptions.statement: 容积率（floor_area_ratio）与建筑控制高度（building_height_m）因官方控规指标未公开，保持待补齐状态，不用占位数字替代。
assumptions.impact: 避免误导法定审批；控规参数公开后可按标准地块划分复算。

assumptions.statement: 若项目推进至实施准备，则资金来源可在财政投资、社会资本、场景运营自平衡三类中组合选择；本方案不预设任何比例、金额或承诺。
assumptions.impact: 为深化阶段提供来源类型框架，实际融资结构、回报边界、公共资产保障与审计安排须经主管部门和专业机构确认。

assumptions.statement_zh: 总体设计范围与三处重点区均为仓库 provisional 粗略边界派生，官方精确红线与正式 polygon 尚未发布；全部面积、比例与区位结论以后者为准复算。
assumptions.statement_en: Overall-design scope and three key areas derive from repository provisional rough polygons; official precise redlines and formal polygons have not been released, and all areas, ratios and location conclusions await recalculation against them.
assumptions.impact: 所有生成图层与几何派生比率为内部可复算，但不得用于权属、审批或工程依据。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: PROV-KEY-003 质心相对大钟寺站存在约 2.26 km 社区争议，本方案仅作粗略定位与场景指向，不支撑该片区边界、权属或实施结论。
assumptions.statement_en: PROV-KEY-003's centroid carries a community dispute of roughly 2.26 km relative to Dazhongsi station; used only for rough placement and scenario pointing.
assumptions.impact: 大钟寺重点区的落位、拆改留与实施结论需待组织方正式几何或经确认的范围说明。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: 容积率、建筑高度、建筑密度等地块控制指标在官方控规公布前保持 unknown/null，是刻意处理而非数据遗漏。
assumptions.statement_en: FAR, building height and density controls remain unknown/null until official regulatory controls are published — a deliberate treatment, not an omission.
assumptions.impact: 任何体量与强度结论须待控制条件齐备后由专业团队建立。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: 道路红线、文保范围及建控地带、水体蓝线、生态控制线与市政管线容量等法定空间管控线尚未获得权威空间数据。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory control lines (road redlines, heritage protection/construction zones, water blue lines, ecological control lines, municipal corridors) lack authoritative spatial data.
assumptions.impact: 相关约束仅以文字性谨慎表述进入方案，不作空间叠加分析。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: 权属、现状建筑安全、消防通行、交通运行与市政容量未经专业核实；拆改留与体量布局为概念建议。
assumptions.statement_en: Ownership, existing-building safety, fire access, traffic operation and municipal capacity are not professionally verified; retention/demolition and massing are conceptual.
assumptions.impact: 一期试点的开工令以 DP 表逐项确认为前提。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: 三个产业测试验证场景无现场基线、标定数据集、主管部门授权或实测结果——方案已如实将其表述为试点触发后的资料。
assumptions.statement_en: The three industry testbeds have no field baseline, calibration dataset, authorization record or measured result; correctly declared as post-trigger materials.
assumptions.impact: 最小验收矩阵为标定阶段结构模板，数值留白。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: 机器色差核验与冗余编码设计不能替代真人测试：视障、老年、行动不便与非智能手机用户的参与式验证被列为开放前验收的触发条件。
assumptions.statement_en: Machine color-simulation cannot substitute human testing; participatory verification with visually-impaired, elderly, mobility-limited and non-smartphone users is a pre-opening trigger.
assumptions.impact: 220 对色觉核验与 39 对例外登记为机器口径；真人测试结果将纳入开放/停用决策。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: 全球案例、铁路史与车站史料为背景级整理，未转化为经专业审阅的权威证据语料；若后续作为法定或遗产设计依据，须先行专业审校。
assumptions.statement_en: Global cases, railway and station histories remain background-level compilations, not an authoritative professionally-reviewed corpus for statutory or heritage-design use.
assumptions.impact: 文化叙事层引用不受影响；法定用途须先行转化。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: 音频导览、概念视频与封面均为本地确定性生成并登记方法链，未经第三方独立检视。
assumptions.statement_en: Audio guides, concept video and cover are locally generated with disclosed method chains, not independently inspected by third parties.
assumptions.impact: 媒体属概念氛围层，非空间证据；字幕与文稿随包提供。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: 场景节点坐标为重点区内的面积级索引点，非勘测安装坐标；不证明地块可得性、施工可行性或点位许可。
assumptions.statement_en: Scenario node coordinates are area-level spatial indices inside key areas, not surveyed installation coordinates; they prove conceptual assignment only.
assumptions.impact: 落位深化需现场勘察与权属确认。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: S/M/L 成本级为概念估算类别（非投资测算）；年度运维成本级同口径，资金来源类型（财政/社会资本/运营自平衡）待责任主体书面确认。
assumptions.statement_en: S/M/L cost tiers are conceptual estimate classes, not investment calculations; annual O&M tiers share the same basis, funding-source types pending written confirmation.
assumptions.impact: DP-06 未确认前仅保留零土建的概念展示与共设计工作坊。
assumptions.source: accumulated reviewer data-gap inventory across PRs #3816/#4020/#4022/#4023/#4024/#4027/#4032/#4038/#4040

assumptions.statement_zh: 八类岗位全部为组织类型规格、assignment_status=unassigned：岗位先于人选，缺岗则绑定场景不开放。
assumptions.statement_en: All eight roles are organisation-type specifications with assignment_status=unassigned: roles before names; bound scenarios stay closed when a role is vacant.
assumptions.impact: 任命机制与互斥规则见 role-spec.json 与正文治理章。
